The original repository license is unchanged. Third-party components retain their own terms.

- `set_transformer.py` is the unchanged `modules.py` from [juho-lee/set_transformer](https://github.com/juho-lee/set_transformer), source blob `3b7e698e14ef7b8e1ea0c419fe51d93e3ee04bf5`. Its MIT license is reproduced in `licenses/set_transformer.txt`.
- `gennbv_encoder.py` adapts the active occupancy/periodic-motion encoder in [GenNBV's released hybrid_encoder.py](https://github.com/zjwzcx/GenNBV/blob/master/gennbv/network/hybrid_encoder.py). The original ETH Zurich/NVIDIA copyright and BSD redistribution text from the upstream LICENSE are reproduced in `licenses/gennbv.txt`. The upstream README also declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the GenNBV work; retain that upstream declaration and consult the original repository for its scope. Changes remove Gym/SB3 construction dependencies, directly accept tensors, pad a finite pose history and resample a declared coarse grid to the original 20³ grid. The graph actor/critic and PPO rollout are a new discrete-action adaptation, not the upstream drone simulator.
- The independent small-MLP radiance implementation uses the diagonal Fisher criterion from [JiangWenPL/FisherRF](https://github.com/JiangWenPL/FisherRF/blob/main/active/H_reg.py): `trace(H_candidate @ inverse(H_observed + lambda*I))`. No FisherRF/3DGS CUDA source is redistributed or relicensed here. The renderer is a differentiable CPU emission/absorption MLP, rather than the upstream Gaussian rasterizer.

Algorithm references: [Set Transformer](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v97/lee19d.html), [GenNBV](https://github.com/zjwzcx/GenNBV), [FisherRF](https://github.com/JiangWenPL/FisherRF), [PPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347).

`air_osvp.py` fetches and invokes the original [AIR-OSVP](https://github.com/psc0628/AIR-OSVP), [PoinTr](https://github.com/yuxumin/PoinTr) and [POCO](https://github.com/valeoai/POCO) sources in a private runtime workspace. Pins are registered in that module. Original PoinTr/POCO license files and submodule licenses remain in the fetched/copied source trees. The pinned AIR release does not contain a root license, so its model/script source is not redistributed by this package. The wrapper implements source staging and common-graph execution/scoring; it does not change or replace native COSC, POCO, pointnet2 or Chamfer operations.
